line: Want it all now? The first spoonful never fills anyone up.
Go slow. Tigers are tamed bit by bit, and so is your breath.
A great painter drew one line every day, even on his busiest days.
credit: Pliny the Elder, on the painter Apelles

line: Looks small? Champions are made from miles and miles of it.
Now you stand steady like a scale, and move like a turning wheel.
Be quick, but don't hurry. They are not the same thing.
Hurry through a maze, and the faster you go, the more tangled you get.
Be the steady tortoise, not the hare who sprints ahead, then naps.
Then, breakthrough. Same push as day one, but the wheel spins faster and faster.
So roll out your mat. The more you do, the more you can do.
